sections.title: The Construction of the Tabernacle Furnishings

blocks.text: Exodus 37 narrates the execution of the tabernacle furnishings, forming part of the broader Exodus literary pattern that presents the sanctuary in two stages: first as divine instruction (Exodus 25), then as completed construction (Exodus 35-37). This construction account demonstrates the same detailed specifications repeated from the earlier commands, with each object described through its materials, dimensions, and assembly. The repeated compliance between command and construction emphasizes the authorized and communal completion of the sanctuary project.
